lines.t: The sky splits open
The earth stands still, a trembling hush, on Zion's hill.
The mighty war, in holy fire, returns with wrath.
And pure desire
He treads the winepress of the proud
His thunder shakes the strongest cloud
The nations fade before his sword
For he alone is King and Lord
The mountains melt beneath his feet
The roaring waves in fear retreat
The heavens quake, creation bends
For the lowly and weak he defends
Yahushua, the king who rides the storm
Clothed in power, fierce and warm
Truth like lightning, eyes ablaze
He reigns forever, ancient of days
Yahushua, breaker of the night
Shining with unending light
Heaven trembling at His call
The King returning over all
His voice ignites the sleeping lands
He gathers justice in his hands
The faithful rise, the wicked fall
For every word he spoke stands tall
His robe is dipped in righteous flame
The host of heaven, God his name
He rides with glory at unseen
The universe before him leans
Yahushua, the king who rides the storm
Clothed in power, fierce and warm
Truth like lightning, eyes ablaze
He reigns forever, ancient of days
Yahushua, breaker of the night
Shining with unending light
Heaven trembling at his call
The king returning over all
The walls fall down, the captives set free
The poor and needy rise in victory
His footsteps ring through every age
His voice, the law, His mercy, the state
True
True
Yahushua, the storm obeys
The nations shake
The mighty King awakes
Yahushua, the King who rides a storm
Clothed in power, fierce and warm
Truth like lightning, eyes ablaze
He reigns forever, ancient of days
Yahushua, breaker of the night
Shining with unending light
Heaven roaring at His call
The King returning over all
When He stands upon the earth in that day
All of darkness will flee away
The storm will bow, the shadows flee
For Yahushua reigns eternally
